---
applyTo: "src/**/*.{c,h}"
---

C Coding Standards
==================

This project uses **C11** as the standard. Follow these conventions when
writing or modifying C code.

> **Note**: These conventions do NOT apply to auto-generated files:
> - `src/lib_*.c` (generated from `.stub` files or compiled Scheme)
> - `src/builtin-*.c` (generated by `tools/scripts/`)
> - Build output directories
>
> Do not manually edit auto-generated files.

Language Standard
-----------------

- Target C11 (`__STDC_VERSION__ >= 201112L`)
- Use C11 features where appropriate (e.g., `_Noreturn`, anonymous unions)
- Ensure compatibility with GCC, Clang, and MSVC

Compatibility Macros
--------------------

Use these macros from `sagittarius/platform.h` for C11 features with
fallbacks for older compilers.

### SG_NORETURN

Mark functions that never return (e.g., exit, panic functions):

```c
SG_EXTERN SG_NORETURN void Sg_Panic(const char* msg, ...);
SG_EXTERN SG_NORETURN void Sg_Exit(int code);
```

| Compiler | Implementation |
|----------|----------------|
| C11+ | `_Noreturn` |
| GCC/Clang | `__attribute__((noreturn))` |
| MSVC | `__declspec(noreturn)` |
| Fallback | Empty |

### SG_STATIC_ASSERT

Compile-time assertions for critical assumptions:

```c
SG_STATIC_ASSERT(sizeof(SgWord) == sizeof(void*),
                 "SgWord must match pointer size");
```

| Compiler | Implementation |
|----------|----------------|
| C11+ | `_Static_assert(cond, msg)` |
| Fallback | Typedef trick (C89 compatible) |

### SG_ALIGNAS

Memory alignment specifier (use sparingly):

```c
SG_ALIGNAS(16) char buffer[1024];
```

| Compiler | Implementation |
|----------|----------------|
| C11+ | `_Alignas(n)` |
| GCC/Clang | `__attribute__((aligned(n)))` |
| MSVC | `__declspec(align(n))` |
| Fallback | Empty |

### SG_INLINE

Inline function hint:

```c
static SG_INLINE int fast_function(int x) { return x * 2; }
```

| Compiler | Implementation |
|----------|----------------|
| C99+/C11 | `inline` |
| GCC/Clang | `__inline__` |
| MSVC | `__inline` |
| Fallback | Empty |

### Legacy Compatibility

`SG_NO_RETURN` is an alias for `SG_NORETURN` for backward compatibility.
Use `SG_NORETURN` in new code.

Naming Conventions
------------------

### Functions

| Scope | Pattern | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| Public API | `Sg_CamelCase` | `Sg_Cons`, `Sg_ArrayToList` |
| Internal API | `Sg__CamelCase` | `Sg__InitSymbol`, `Sg__PostInitVM` |
| Static/Local | `snake_case` | `make_pair`, `array_to_list_with_tail` |
| Init functions | `Sg__Init_module_name` | `Sg__Init_sagittarius_vm` |

### Types

| Kind | Pattern | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| Type alias | `SgCamelCase` | `SgObject`, `SgPair`, `SgWord` |
| Struct | `SgTypeRec` | `SgPairRec`, `SgHeaderRec` |
| Class pointer | `SG_CLASS_TYPE` | `SG_CLASS_PAIR`, `SG_CLASS_LIST` |

### Macros

| Kind | Pattern | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| General macros | `SG_UPPER_CASE` | `SG_NEW`, `SG_MALLOC` |
| Type predicates | `SG_TYPEP` | `SG_PAIRP`, `SG_NULLP` |
| Accessors | `SG_FIELD` | `SG_CAR`, `SG_CDR` |
| Setters | `SG_SET_FIELD` | `SG_SET_CAR`, `SG_SET_CDR` |

### Variables

- Use `snake_case` for all variables: `warn_proc`, `list_cpl`
- Suffix with `P` for predicate flags: `initializingP`, `nullTermP`

File Structure
--------------

### Source Files (.c)

```c
/* filename.c                                      -*- mode:c; coding:utf-8; -*-
 *
 *   Copyright (c) 2010-2021  Takashi Kato <ktakashi@ymail.com>
 *   ... (BSD 2-clause license) ...
 */
#define LIBSAGITTARIUS_BODY
#include "sagittarius/private/module.h"
/* other includes */

/* static variables */
/* static functions */
/* public functions */
```

### Header Files (.h)

```c
/* module.h                                        -*- mode:c; coding:utf-8; -*-
 *   ... (copyright and license) ...
 */
#ifndef SAGITTARIUS_PRIVATE_MODULE_H_
#define SAGITTARIUS_PRIVATE_MODULE_H_

#include "sagittariusdefs.h"
/* other includes */

/* struct definitions */
/* macro definitions */

SG_CDECL_BEGIN

/* function declarations */

SG_CDECL_END

#endif /* SAGITTARIUS_PRIVATE_MODULE_H_ */
```

### Header Guard Format

- Private headers: `SAGITTARIUS_PRIVATE_MODULE_H_`
- Public headers: `SAGITTARIUS_MODULE_H_`

Code Style
----------

### Comments

- Use `/* */` style for all comments (C89 compatibility in comments)
- Block comments for file headers and major sections
- Inline comments for non-obvious logic

```c
/* This is a block comment explaining
   a complex algorithm or section */

static void helper_function()
{
  int value = compute(); /* inline comment */
}
```

### Braces and Indentation

- Opening brace on same line for functions and control structures
- 2-space indentation
- No tabs

```c
static SgObject make_object(SgObject arg)
{
  if (SG_NULLP(arg)) {
    return SG_NIL;
  } else {
    return process(arg);
  }
}
```

### Function Definitions

- Return type on same line as function name for short declarations
- Multi-line for long parameter lists

```c
SgObject Sg_Cons(SgObject car, SgObject cdr)
{
  /* implementation */
}

static SgObject helper_with_long_params(SgObject first_param,
                                        SgObject second_param,
                                        SgObject third_param)
{
  /* implementation */
}
```

Memory Management
-----------------

Use Boehm GC allocation macros:

```c
SG_NEW(type)              /* Allocate single object */
SG_NEW2(type, size)       /* Allocate with custom size */
SG_NEW_ARRAY(type, n)     /* Allocate array */
SG_NEW_ATOMIC(type)       /* Allocate atomic (no pointers) */
```

Do NOT use:
- `malloc()`, `calloc()`, `realloc()` directly
- `free()` (GC handles deallocation)

Error Handling
--------------

### Severity Levels

| Function | When to Use |
|----------|-------------|
| `Sg_Panic` | **Fatal errors only** - Runtime must shutdown (e.g., OOM, corrupted state) |
| `Sg_Error` | General error reporting |
| `Sg_Warn` | Non-fatal warnings |

### Specific Error Functions (Preferred)

Use specific error functions when applicable:

```c
/* I/O errors */
Sg_IOError(type, who, msg, file, port);
Sg_IOReadError(who, msg, port, irritants);
Sg_IOWriteError(who, msg, port, irritants);
Sg_IOFileDoesNotExistError(file, who, msg);
Sg_IOFileAlreadyExistsError(file, who, msg);
Sg_IODecodingError(port, who, msg);
Sg_IOEncodingError(port, char, who, msg);
Sg_IOFilenameError(file, who, msg);
Sg_IOFileProtectionError(file, who, msg);

/* Type/argument errors */
Sg_WrongTypeOfArgumentViolation(who, requiredType, gotValue, irritants);
Sg_WrongNumberOfArgumentsViolation(who, required, got, irritants);
Sg_WrongNumberOfArgumentsAtLeastViolation(who, required, got, irritants);
Sg_WrongNumberOfArgumentsBetweenViolation(who, start, end, got, irritants);

/* Other violations */
Sg_AssertionViolation(who, message, irritants);
Sg_UndefinedViolation(who, message);
Sg_ImplementationRestrictionViolation(who, message, irritants);

/* Syntax/read errors */
Sg_SyntaxError(form, irritants);
Sg_ReadError(UC("message"), ...);
Sg_SystemError(errno, UC("message"), ...);
```

### General Error (Fallback)

Use `Sg_Error` only when no specific function applies:

```c
Sg_Error(UC("unexpected condition: %S"), value);
```

Include Patterns
----------------

### In Source Files

```c
#define LIBSAGITTARIUS_BODY
#include "sagittarius/private/module.h"
```

### Order of Includes

1. Config headers (`sagittarius/config.h`)
2. System headers (`<string.h>`, `<stdio.h>`)
3. Project private headers (`sagittarius/private/...`)
4. Local headers

CLOS Integration
----------------

When defining built-in classes:

```c
static SgClass *type_cpl[] = {
  SG_CLASS_TYPE,
  SG_CLASS_TOP,
  NULL
};
SG_DEFINE_BUILTIN_CLASS(Sg_TypeClass, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, type_cpl);
```

Stub Files
----------

`.stub` files generate C code for Scheme-C bindings. When adding new
bindings, create or modify the corresponding `.stub` file and run
`./dist.sh stub` to regenerate.
